tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. The only page ground - the site is dark-only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Terminal cards (neofetch, learning log, ping), chips. One step above bg.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Outline button hover, active language tab.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: section dividers, header and footer borders, rows inside cards, card title bar.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and control borders: terminal cards, outline button, language switch, education cards.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: neofetch separator dashes, link underline colour.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Outline button border on hover; list bullet dash.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings, name, primary text, emphasised words in the About paragraph.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Experience bullets, neofetch values, card body text. 13:1 on bg.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: tagline, dates, mono labels, footer, inactive language tabs. 7.8:1 on bg - the floor for small text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Emerald. Prompt user, section commands, role line, status dot, cursor, primary button fill, spinner. 7.3:1 on bg. One accent only.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Accent at 18% - background rain glyph tint, quiet accent washes. Never behind text.

tokens.name: log-ghost
tokens.usage: Background log text. Decorative only, never readable content.

styles.name: display-name
styles.usage: Hero name only. clamp(52px, 8vw, 96px); 54px on phones. Two lines.

styles.name: display-contact
styles.usage: Contact section heading - the page's closing beat. 44px on phones.

styles.name: heading-section

styles.name: heading-entry
styles.usage: Company names in Experience, UNEC. 24px on phones.

styles.name: role

styles.usage: Hero tagline and contact line, in muted.

styles.usage: Experience bullets and all running text. 15px on phones.

styles.usage: Inside terminal cards: learning log, ping output.
